rationale: The claim is strictly scoped to the empirical findings of Guo et al. (2017) regarding the miscalibration of studied modern neural networks and the empirical effectiveness of temperature scaling on their evaluated benchmarks. The challenge condition—that calibration on a held-out distribution does not constitute a system-level safety bound or guarantee calibration under OOD/operational distribution shift—is consistently preserved across all artifact uses without overclaiming.
limitations: The review relies on the provided Guo et al. arXiv paper excerpts and artifact text; it does not evaluate post-2017 calibration architectures or system-level closed-loop behavior under severe operational distribution shifts.
